title: Το δάσος
description: Ten texts about the forest: a school trip to a pond, a fire report, a council debate, a woodcutter, a recovery diary, a moonlit night, a village fair, a forest guard in a blizzard, a profile and an open-air theatre.

lessons.title: Η λιμνούλα του δάσους
lessons.summary: A biology teacher takes her class to a forest pond for water sampling, and a pale boy from Athens turns out to be the most careful of them all.

lessons.title: Η νύχτα της πυρκαγιάς
lessons.summary: A news report on a pine-forest fire below a mountain range that grows suddenly in the wind and is held back overnight before it reaches the villages.

lessons.title: Ένα δάσος δίπλα στο διυλιστήριο
lessons.summary: A local paper reports on a council meeting where a retired chemist defends the small pine forest between the refinery and the houses, and the council decides to keep looking after it.

lessons.title: Ο παππούς και η σφήνα
lessons.summary: A young man spends a winter week in his grandfather's mountain village and learns from him to split logs with a steel wedge, slowly and with respect for the forest.

lessons.title: Ημερολόγιο μιας αναρρωτικής άδειας
lessons.summary: An accountant on sick leave after a blood clot keeps a diary of his daily walks in the forest above Thessaloniki, and slowly changes his habits.

lessons.title: Πανσέληνος στο δάσος
lessons.summary: A retired physicist leads a small astronomy evening in a forest clearing on Mount Cholomontas and explains the moon and the planets to a curious girl.

lessons.title: Το πανηγύρι στο ξέφωτο του δάσους
lessons.summary: A nineteen-year-old student helps her aunt decorate a forest clearing for the village's summer fair, and the evening ends with halva, kebab and dancing under an old cherry tree.

lessons.title: Ο δασοφύλακας του Κισσάβου
lessons.summary: A local history column tells how an old notebook found in a ruined forest post brought back the story of a forest guard who, in the blizzard of 1956, led twelve lost woodcutters to shelter.

lessons.title: Από το κομμωτήριο στο δάσος της Δαδιάς
lessons.summary: A profile of a hairdresser from Piraeus who sold her salon, moved to a village by the Dadia forest and now runs a small guesthouse for people who come to see the vultures.

lessons.title: Μια βραδιά στο Θέατρο Δάσους
lessons.summary: The props man of a small company describes an opening night at the open-air Forest Theatre in Thessaloniki, from the costumes on their hangers to a squirrel on stage and whipped cream after the show.
